I will state that I have not received a new list and that the only list I have from him is the one from 14:00. I will reiterate that I have already analyzed that list and found no compatible times, and I sent him a detailed breakdown of the conflicts. This puts the ball back in his court and clarifies my position. It addresses both possibilities (system error or his mistake) without being accusatory.
